import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax1.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.1f}h', va='center', fontsize=10)

# 2. BMI Category Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
ax2.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 3. Sleep Quality vs Physical Activity
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', s=150, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax3.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Physical Activity\n(Color: Stress Level)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')

# 4. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors_bar = ['#2ecc71' if x == 'None' else '#e74c3c' for x in disorder_counts.index]
ax4.bar(disorder_counts.index, disorder_counts.values, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')
for i, v in enumerate(disorder_counts.values):
    ax4.text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
colors_bmi = {'Normal': '#3498db', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax5.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                label=bmi, c=colors_bmi[bmi], s=150, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps by BMI')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix')
plt.setp(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
